description: This file defines a Router class for intercepting and handling network requests within a Playwright testing context, including request handling, route management, and fetch override logic.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: A class for managing request interception, handling, and route management in Playwright browser contexts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Router with a Playwright browser context and optional base URL.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Adds a route with specified arguments to the context and stores it.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Registers request handlers and updates route interception accordingly.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes all request handlers and unroutes all stored routes.

methods.name: _updateRequestHandlersRoute
methods.description: Internal method to enable or disable request handling route based on current handlers.
